printed_source_line: Source: National Park Service, Visitor Use Statistics (IRMA), recreation visits, 2025, the 15 most visited of the 63 national parks, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. A count of visits, not of separate people; national parks only, not the Service’s other sites.

source_line_variants.top_12: Source: National Park Service, Visitor Use Statistics (IRMA), recreation visits, 2025, the 12 most visited of the 63 national parks, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. A count of visits, not of separate people; national parks only, not the Service’s other sites.

domain_note: Visits to national parks measure the use of a public service a federal agency runs, the public services side of V7 domain D04
notes: Made November 12, 2026 for Rule 14.6’s correct plate (the editor’s ED-R3, D3-624). The 400 units in the service’s answer sum to its own system totals in every month of 2025 (323,014,305 recreation visits), and each of the 63 parks reports all 12 months. Files read: visitation-2025.json (SHA-256 prefix a6808098cd86ca10) and total-2025.json (3bcabc096e76536e).
states is empty: the chart names parks, not states, and the 15 parks lie in many states; Great Smoky Mountains, the largest, spans Tennessee and North Carolina.
unconfirmed: The Service’s own definition of a recreation visit was not read (its definitions page was not found); the qualification says only what the counts are
